core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghayda is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Thicket”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: No verified lexical identification was established for Ghayda. Ghayda corresponds to the feminine form of غيداء (Ghaydāʾ) — غيد (Ghayd) — describing a graceful, slender young woman, from the root غ ي د. The source gave the unrelated غيضة ('thicket') and the gloss 'guide, leader', neither of which belongs to this name. The 'graceful' reading is recorded at medium confidence given the source's conflicting columns. No meaning is asserted, because asserting one would require inventing evidence.
